text:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] Auto-detect: sustained spike on /v1/embeddings (shared edge). Queue depth rising, proxy 5xxs increasing. Pager duty: sam_oncall

sam_oncall: I'm oncall — pinging infra and SRE. Any immediate customer hits? :phone:

maria_infra: Two enterprise tenants showing 503s (acme-slice, beta-inc). Embeds traffic ~2x baseline, backend queues for shared pool are saturated. Chat route p95 briefly spiked due to head-of-line when proxies backpressure.

lee_sre: Proposed immediate actions: 1) apply per-endpoint QPS cap on shared embeddings route (non-dedicated) to reduce ingress; 2) whitelist enterprise tenant(s) to preserve their SLA; 3) disable rerank calls for non-enterprise clients as a fast-fail to save cycles.

sam_oncall: I can push the caps. What's the exact command?

maria_infra: Two options: CLI or API. CLI: `./adminctl set-quota --route embeddings --scope shared --qps 0.3`

—or—

API: `POST https://console.internal/api/v1/quota`
Body: `{"route":"embeddings","scope":"shared","qps":0.3}`

I'm executing the API now, will post link to change.

devops-bot: change-job: starting quota update (job id: qcap-2026-09-12-01) by maria_infra — https://console/job/qcap-2026-09-12-01

sam_oncall: Applied. Observing metrics: p50 looks stable, p95 dropped from ~2.1s to ~1.1s, 503 rate down ~80%. Good initial effect.

sanjay_pm: Two paying customers filed degraded-embeddings earlier. We should confirm impact window and message CS. Any ETA on rerank restore?

lee_sre: Rerank: disable for non-dedicated clients for now. We won't re-enable until shared queue-latency < target for 3 consecutive 5-min windows. Restore plan: stepwise restore +10% every 10 minutes while monitoring errors. Notify CS and account teams now.

sam_oncall: @maria can you add a tenant-level allow rule for acme-slice so they get full QPS? Need to ensure dedicated pools unaffected.

maria_infra: Adding tag-based whitelist: `./adminctl add-rule --route embeddings --match "tenant==acme-slice" --qps 1.0` — running now.

devops-bot: rule-add success (rule id: rule-acme-1977). acme-slice shows healthy metrics; beta-inc still reports a few 5xxs (~5%).

lee_sre: Monitoring notes: cause looks like an external traffic burst from an upstream partner hitting embeddings hot keys. Mitigation: shared-route cap + tenant whitelist + rerank off for non-dedicated. Next steps: 1) keep cap in place for 30m; 2) if metrics stable, restore in increments; 3) prepare postmortem and customer notif. I'll draft handoff notes for next oncall.

sam_oncall: OK preparing handoff. Current status: mitigated (reduced error rate) but still under watch. Escalate if 5xxs >10% or latency p95 >1.5s for >2 consecutive 5-min windows.

next_oncall: copying notes — will keep eyes on it during next shift. Please add links to dashboards and the list of affected tenants in the incident doc.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated; severity=high; mitigation=per-endpoint-qps-cap + tenant-whitelist + rerank-disabled; owner=sam_oncall; monitor-window=30m

sam_oncall: Adding meeting / postmortem invite with CS & eng after monitoring window. :calendar:
